items.caption: A modern rendering of traditional 問 in Shuowen seal-script style. The received analysis assigns 口 the meaning role and 門 the sound role, though the available sound comparisons do not independently establish that correspondence.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style 問 with two upper side enclosures above a large central enclosure, all held within tall outer strokes.
items.selection_reason: This legible rendering shows the received form and its analyzed components; it does not establish a lineage from the disputed Shang graphs.

limitations.text: This is a modern vector redraw, not an excavated artifact. Shang graphs combining 門 and 口 have been identified as 問, but that reading and their relationship to the later form remain disputed; a proposal that they are expanded forms of 啟 is tentative.
